notes: Timestamps are local Brazilian time, stored without a time zone.
Orders span 2016-09-04 to 2018-10-17, but only 2017-01 through 2018-08 has complete monthly volume. 2016 is sparse (no orders at all in 2016-11) and 2018-09/2018-10 hold only 20 orders.

2017-01-01 to 2018-08-31 is the recommended window for trends and period comparisons (ADR 0013). Do not add this filter automatically; when a question asks about any period, use exactly that period, and when it touches 2016 or 2018-09/2018-10, state that those months are incomplete.
Customer and seller locations are Brazilian cities and two-letter state codes (e.g. SP, RJ).
Product categories are English snake_case names (e.g. health_beauty, bed_bath_table).

glossary.meaning: A real person, identified by customer_unique_id. Never count per-order customer IDs.
Merchandise revenue (metric revenue) unless the question says orders or units.
customer_state or seller_state (two-letter Brazilian state code).
freight (freight_value / freight_total), reported separately from revenue.

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: Orders
metrics.definition: Number of orders placed, all statuses, unless the question restricts the status.

metrics.name: cancellation_rate
metrics.label: Cancellation rate
metrics.definition: Share of all orders whose status is canceled.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.label: Merchandise revenue
metrics.definition: Merchandise revenue. Sum of item prices, excluding freight, for orders that are not canceled or unavailable and that contain at least one item.

metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.label: Average order value
metrics.definition: Revenue divided by the number of revenue orders.

metrics.name: items_sold
metrics.label: Items sold
metrics.definition: Number of item units in revenue orders.

metrics.name: freight_value
metrics.label: Freight value
metrics.definition: Freight charged on items in revenue orders.

metrics.name: total_order_value
metrics.label: Total order value
metrics.definition: Item prices plus freight for revenue orders (what the customer was charged before payment-plan effects).

metrics.name: payment_value
metrics.label: Payment value
metrics.definition: Sum of payment records for revenue orders.

metrics.name: average_review_score
metrics.label: Average review score
metrics.definition: Mean score (1-5) of each reviewed order's latest review.

metrics.name: low_rating_rate
metrics.label: Low rating rate
metrics.definition: Share of reviewed orders whose latest review scored 1 or 2.

metrics.name: late_delivery_rate
metrics.label: Late delivery rate
metrics.definition: Share of delivered orders (with a delivery date) that arrived after the estimated delivery date, compared by calendar date.

metrics.name: average_delivery_days
metrics.label: Average delivery time
metrics.definition: Mean days from purchase to customer delivery for delivered orders.

metrics.name: average_delivery_delay_days
metrics.label: Average delivery delay vs estimate
metrics.definition: Mean of delivered date minus estimated delivery date, in whole calendar days, for delivered orders. Positive = late, negative = early; Olist deliveries average about 12 days early.

metrics.name: repeat_customer_rate
metrics.label: Repeat customer rate
metrics.definition: Share of customers with at least one delivered order who have at least two delivered orders.

columns.name: is_canceled

columns.name: is_revenue_order
columns.description: True when the order counts toward revenue: status is not canceled or unavailable and the order has items.

columns.description: When the customer placed the order.

columns.description: True when delivered after the estimated delivery date. NULL unless delivered with a delivery date.

columns.name: delivery_delay_days

columns.name: delivery_days
